subject: FontCloud pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) for trial
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@fontcloud.io>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts@fontcloud.io
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FontCloud pilot — onboarding & PO requirement question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we appreciated the thoughtful questions from your team. We're excited to pilot Redwood with a small group (3 seats) for the next 30 days. The pilot cost will be a single invoice for $8,450.

As a small company we typically run pilots on an invoice-only basis (no PO). Before we send the invoice, can you confirm Redwood's procurement requirements for pilot engagements? Specifically: 1) do you require a PO for one-off trials under $10k, and 2) what onboarding evidence (W-9, SOC2 summary, vendor form) do you need?

I've attached our W-9 and a brief SOC2 summary. Happy to complete any vendor intake forms you provide. If an invoice-only path is acceptable we can route invoices to accounts@fontcloud.io.

Appreciate your guidance — hoping to get this live early next week.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Finance, FontCloud
emily.zhao@fontcloud.io
attachments: fontcloud_w9.pdf, fontcloud_soc2_summary.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@fontcloud.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FontCloud pilot — onboarding & PO requirement question

Hi Emily — great to hear, and glad the demo went well.

Short answer: Redwood typically issues POs for ongoing vendor relationships, but we do have a temporary invoice-only pathway for short pilots and small one-off purchases. There are a few conditions we'll need to meet before we can mark FontCloud as "invoice-only" for this pilot:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- W-9 on file (you already sent — thanks)
- SOC2 or security summary (we received your summary)
- Procurement approval for a temporary allowance (I'll loop in procurement)
- Finance routing: invoices must be sent to invoices@redwoodinference.com and reference the onboarding ticket number

@Karthik / @Marissa — can you weigh in on thresholds and any T&Cs we need (temporary allowlist, spend cap, duration)? Marissa, if Legal needs to sign an addendum, please advise.

Emily — if procurement approves we can aim for a 60–90 day temporary invoice-only window for this pilot and I'll confirm routing details.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FontCloud pilot — onboarding & PO requirement question

Thanks, Tessa. Quick procurement note:

We can provisionally approve a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, subject to the following constraints (standard practice):

1) Duration: 90 days max from activation
2) Cumulative spend cap across the window: $15,000 (we can lower if Finance requests)
3) Vendor must complete onboarding form + provide W-9 and a SOC2 summary
4) Vendor agrees to our temporary allowlist addendum (we'll issue a short T&C PDF)
5) All invoices must be sent to invoices@redwoodinference.com and include the Redwood onboarding ticket ID and an email reference to the Redwood sponsor (Tessa)

I'm attaching a draft "temporary_allowlist_t&c.pdf" that we use for pilots. Laura — can Finance confirm if $15k is acceptable or if you want a lower threshold for this supplier category?

Marissa — if Legal wants to tweak the addendum text please mark changes. Once we have Finance confirmation we'll send this to the vendor for signature.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
attachments: temporary_allowlist_t&c.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FontCloud pilot — onboarding & PO requirement question

Thanks for the context. Finance is generally supportive of a temporary invoice-only path for small pilots, but we want to limit our exposure. Proposed Finance guardrails:

- Approve a $10,000 cap for invoice-only pilots by default.
- For pilots that may exceed $10k, require pre-approval from Finance and a PO setup going forward.
- Require vendor invoices to include Redwood's onboarding ticket ID and be billed to the corporate billing address.

If FontCloud confirms the pilot will be a single invoice for $8,450, Finance can sign off on the temporary invoice-only pathway. Please get the vendor to sign the temporary_allowlist_t&c.pdf and return the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf. Once we have those we will authorize Accounts Payable to process the invoice without a PO.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
